en.title: Asset Analysis
en.stamp: As of Wednesday, September 30, 2026. Rising real yields and widening credit spreads set the tone.
en.banner: The tape is being driven by the rise in the 10 year real yield to **2.91%** alongside a widening high yield spread at **308 bp**, which pressures every long duration asset at once. The Fed funds effective rate is holding at **3.88%** while core CPI slows to **2.4%** year over year, so cash still pays while risk assets absorb the tightening.

assets.name: US Stocks
assets.one: Rising real yields and widening credit spreads outweigh firm growth and a calm VIX.
assets.qual: bottoming, the index sits only 2.1% below its 52 week high and volatility is low, so the downside is being absorbed rather than accelerating

factors.b: Industrial production grew **1.4%** year over year in August, holding firm.
The high yield OAS widened to **308 bp** from **273 bp** over five sessions.
The VIX sits at **16.34**, low and near its recent range.

assets.name: US Cash
assets.one: The Fed funds rate is held high and real carry on cash is solidly positive.
assets.qual: cash pays a real 1.80% over core inflation while policy stays on hold

factors.b: The Fed funds effective rate is held at **3.88%** across the last five observations.
Real carry over core CPI stands at **1.80%**.
The S&P 500 at **7,652** sits only **2.1%** below its 52 week high, a strong risk on backdrop.

assets.name: Gold
assets.one: Rising real yields, a firm dollar and a break below the 200 day average weigh on gold.
assets.qual: gold trades 8.0% below its 200 day average with real yields still climbing, and only rising breakevens offer support

factors.b: The 10 year real yield rose to **2.91%** from **2.76%** over five observations.
The dollar index at **101.45** stands **2.2%** above its 200 day average.
The 10 year breakeven edged up to **2.36%** from **2.33%**.

assets.name: Crypto
assets.one: High real yields, a rising dollar and widening spreads bite, but price holds well above its moving averages.
assets.qual: bottoming, bitcoin holds 17.4% above its 200 day average, so the trend is absorbing the macro pressure for now

factors.b: The 10 year real yield at **2.91%** is high and rising.
The dollar index rose to **101.45**, up **0.3%** over five sessions.
Bitcoin at **$83,692** trades **17.4%** above its 200 day average of **$71,263**.

tiles.read: The 10 year real yield at 2.91% is climbing and sits at the top of its recent range, a direct headwind for duration assets.
The 10 year nominal yield at 5.26% has risen steadily from 5.11%, tightening financial conditions.
The breakeven at 2.36% is drifting higher, showing inflation expectations are firm but contained.
The high yield OAS at 308 bp has widened sharply from 273 bp, signaling growing credit stress.
The 3 month T bill at 4.25% holds above the Fed funds rate, keeping short term cash well paid.
The Fed funds effective rate at 3.88% has been flat across five observations, a steady policy stance.
The VIX at 16.34 is low, so equity fear has not yet caught up with the widening credit spread.
The S&P 500 at 7,652 is only 2.1% below its 52 week high, drifting lower rather than breaking down.
Bitcoin at $83,692 is off just 0.4% over five sessions and holds far above its moving averages.

zh.title: 资产分析
zh.stamp: 截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日，星期三。 实际利率上升与信用利差走阔定下基调。
zh.banner: 市场主线由 10 年期实际利率升至 **2.91%** 以及高收益利差走阔至 **308 bp** 主导，两者同时压制所有长久期资产。联邦基金有效利率维持在 **3.88%**，核心 CPI 同比放缓至 **2.4%**，现金仍有回报，而风险资产正在消化紧缩压力。

assets.name: 美股
assets.one: 实际利率上升与信用利差走阔，压过稳健的增长与平静的 VIX。
assets.qual: 筑底，指数仅比 52 周高点低 2.1%，波动率处于低位，下行压力正被吸收而非加速

factors.b: 8 月工业产出同比增长 **1.4%**，保持稳健。
高收益 OAS 在五个交易日内从 **273 bp** 走阔至 **308 bp**。
VIX 处于 **16.34**，低位且接近近期区间。

assets.name: 美元现金
assets.one: 联邦基金利率维持高位，现金的实际回报为显著正值。
assets.qual: 现金相对核心通胀的实际回报为 1.80%，政策保持不变

factors.h: 联邦基金利率水平与倾向
factors.b: 联邦基金有效利率在最近五次观测中维持在 **3.88%**。
相对核心 CPI 的实际回报为 **1.80%**。
标普 500 指数报 **7,652**，仅比 52 周高点低 **2.1%**，风险偏好环境强劲。

assets.name: 黄金
assets.one: 实际利率上升、美元走强以及跌破 200 日均线共同压制黄金。
assets.qual: 黄金较 200 日均线低 8.0%，实际利率仍在攀升，仅盈亏平衡通胀上升提供支撑

factors.b: 10 年期实际利率在五次观测中从 **2.76%** 升至 **2.91%**。
10 年期盈亏平衡通胀率小幅升至 **2.36%**，此前为 **2.33%**。

assets.name: 加密资产
assets.one: 高企的实际利率、走强的美元与走阔的利差构成压力，但价格仍远高于其均线。
assets.qual: 筑底，比特币较 200 日均线高出 17.4%，趋势目前仍在吸收宏观压力

factors.b: 10 年期实际利率报 **2.91%**，处于高位且仍在上升。
美元指数升至 **101.45**，五个交易日内上涨 **0.3%**。

tiles.read: 10 年期实际利率报 2.91%，持续攀升并处于近期区间顶部，对久期资产构成直接阻力。
10 年期名义利率报 5.26%，自 5.11% 稳步上升，金融状况趋紧。
盈亏平衡通胀率报 2.36%，缓慢上行，显示通胀预期稳固但受控。
高收益 OAS 报 308 bp，自 273 bp 大幅走阔，显示信用压力上升。
3 个月期国库券报 4.25%，高于联邦基金利率，短期现金回报良好。
联邦基金有效利率报 3.88%，五次观测保持平稳，政策立场稳定。
VIX 报 16.34，处于低位，股票市场的恐慌尚未跟上信用利差的走阔。
标普 500 报 7,652，仅比 52 周高点低 2.1%，缓慢回落而非破位下行。
